acceptance: Synchronize the verified provider v0.5.64 release.json and release-digests.json assets through scripts/sync_published_release_projection.py with their exact SHA-256 digests and source identity d35ec3d7467e5ef4540e7a328c24bd8dc29dab33.

The synchronized repository projection records release.json=v0.5.64, advances next-release.json and release-state.json to the next unused candidate v0.5.65, reserves v0.5.64, and updates .ai/cockpit/version.json and install.sh consistently.
No immutable provider tag, Release, asset, historical archive, or unrelated Work Item is changed.
make check-release-state-consistency, make check-release-distribution, make check-release-readiness, and source-bound evidence checks pass on the resulting clean candidate.
The Work Item finishes only with a complete direct conversation-visible Outcome carrying the canonical traffic-light marker and a green terminal gate.
guidelines: Use the canonical projection synchronizer; do not hand-edit generated release metadata.
Treat provider release assets and immutable tags as read-only evidence.
Do not create a tag or public Release before the candidate and same-SHA rehearsal gates pass.

intent.problem: The repository candidate still identifies v0.5.64 as unpublished even though GitHub already has an immutable stable v0.5.64 Release. A release rehearsal correctly rejected the reused tag before any new mutation.
constraints: Use the exact public v0.5.64 release assets as the authority.
Keep the already merged Outcome lifecycle WI closed and immutable.
Do not publish from a stale or locally hand-edited candidate.
intent.rationale: Synchronizing the actual provider projection first is the smallest independent release-scope correction and prevents the next publication from reusing an occupied immutable version.
